currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM; no bespoke survey/plan tracing/LiDAR and no redistributed photographs.

pictures.observations: Side view: pale gray stone barrel roof with transverse ribs, lower curved aisle roof, upper round clerestory windows, curved transept end with small rose, square crossing base and octagonal drum with narrow rounded windows, pointed eight-rib stone dome and small gold finial/cross. Sculptures/head frieze not reproduced exactly.

West and northern facade: large central rose below curved barrel-end crown/small upper rose, smaller side oculi and curved aisle shoulders, recessed pointed main portal, northern Lion Portal and repeated blind round side bays/pilasters. All exterior appears pale limestone/sandstone rather than terracotta roof. Exact figures/reliefs and complete traceries excluded.
